EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows an aldehydic C–H stretch at ~2740 cm⁻¹, a strong indicator of a –CHO group; among the candidates, only 6 (C/C=C(\C=O)CC) is an α,β-unsaturated aldehyde. The carbonyl band at 1719 cm⁻¹ fits an aldehyde C=O influenced by conjugation, and the 1643 cm⁻¹ band matches a C=C stretch in an enal (GFQ-010). Multiple C–H stretches (2936, 2989, 3115 cm⁻¹) align with mixed sp³/sp² environments, and the ~859 cm⁻¹ feature is consistent with vinyl out-of-plane bending. Other candidates (ketone, ester, acid, amide, imine) lack the characteristic aldehydic C–H band near 2740 cm⁻¹ and/or show mismatched carbonyl behavior.
